purpose: Keep Peris fantasy anatomy and equipment recognizable while retaining its own portrait direction.
referenceUse: Appearance studies. Source models are used only when separately credited and explicitly fitted; movie/game illustrations are not runtime meshes.

primarySources.use: Exposed skeleton warriors/spearmen, grave armor and ragged cloth, skeletal and barded skeletal mounts. Reference archetypes; Peris keeps its own ranged roster.

raceChecks.elf: Slender proportions, connected pointed ears, refined warm face, flowing hair, fitted leaf armor and fine weapons. Avoid an alien head or bearded human silhouette.
raceChecks.dwarf: Short stocky body, substantial head and beard, broad hands/boots, worked iron and leather, tools and heavy weapon grips.
raceChecks.gnome: Small engineer build, connected distinctive nose, hair/beard, fitted goggles, brass/gear details, practical tools. Avoid a smaller dwarf copy.
raceChecks.pandaren: Bear muzzle and jaws, round ears, anatomical eye masks, broad paws and belly, jade/copper lamellar military kit and red cloth.
raceChecks.undead: Real skull/jaw and paired limb bones, open ribs/pelvis, bony hands, rusted and torn kit; retain complete skeletal mount anatomy.
raceChecks.demon: Distinct two-eyed angular red face, rooted swept horns, claw/hoof anatomy and dark crafted armor. Avoid a red recolor of the Orc face.

approval: Art direction checklist, not a claim that all models have passed final visual review.
